title: bundle hygiene: validate-before-write in writeBundleSession + S7 compaction/rotation with an enforced size sensor (R11 + R10, coordinate R29)
description: Deep-review sweep #2 (2026-07-06) MEDIUM findings R11 (F11+F44) + R10 (F10+F47), adversarially confirmed. (a) src/bundle.js:101-106 stringifies any payload straight to disk; bundleStateSchema is compiled only in tests (which don't exist in consumer projects) while task-store/knowledge-graph/knowledge all validate before write — the bundle is the lone unguarded state file. (b) The live bundle measured 260,742 bytes / 1,084+ lines (decisions ~131KB/80+ entries, subagent_results ~70KB/63 entries, handoff_summary a single 44KB string), violating SKILL.md:55-59's paragraph/~1000-char contract; schema length caps were deliberately removed (src/schemas.js:46-56) with no replacing sensor; every phase-boundary checkpoint rewrites the whole file (4+ per ticket) and RESUME-FIRST burns ~65K tokens per new chat; Read-tool truncation (2000 lines) is ~2 drives away. Coordinate with R29: 12-13 decision graph nodes ref the live session.json (4 via non-resolvable #timestamp fragments) — rotation must keep archived decisions addressable. Full context: synthesis §R10 §R11 §R29.
acceptance_criteria: writeBundleSession validates the payload against bundleStateSchema before atomicWriteFile and throws a typed E_BUNDLE_INVALID carrying ajv error paths — red-first spec; all existing writers stay green.

Compaction/rotation implemented: session.json retains required fields + mode/loop_auth/loop_state counters + the latest handoff_summary + the most recent N decisions/subagent_results; older entries rotate to an append-only archive file inside the bundle dir (no data loss).
An enforced size sensor exists (schema maxItems/maxLength or a fast-tier spec) that fails when session.json exceeds the documented caps — red-proven against a synthetic oversized bundle.

The live bundle is compacted once via the new mechanism on the record; graph decision-node refs remain addressable afterwards (repointed to archived locations or preserved paths — R29 coordination documented).
RESUME-FIRST documentation (SKILL.md both copies + state/README.md) reflects the compacted layout and the rotation lifecycle.

VERIFICATION: loop-ctl resume-point → action=resume, TASK-103, phase test, iteration 8, completed_this_run 7 (drive state survived verbatim); get-mode → loop; tests/live-state.spec.js 1/1 green (was the suite's one expected red).
